soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 1 and ass:root-neighborhood-differentiability / ass:score-derivative-lipschitz
soundness_flags.one_line: The L2 ball B_beta(delta) permits perturbed propensities equal to zero on small positive-probability sets, so the perturbed score terms A_t/tilde-pi_t and hence the claimed Frechet map P Psi_s(tilde-beta;b) are not defined on its stated domain.

soundness_flags.label: ass:price-jacobian-small-variation
soundness_flags.one_line: Given the common Jacobian modulus, uniform nonsingularity, and an existential common local radius, the radius can be shrunk to make the rho_eta/2 variation bound hold; retain it as a radius choice or remove it as an extra assumption.

soundness_flags.label: prop:face-geometry
soundness_flags.one_line: The proposition calls the comparator mechanism exponential/Kullback--Leibler tilting although the proposal's displayed optimizer is clipped-affine from a quadratic perspective criterion; use the correct quadratic terminology and verify the comparator's exact Proposition 3 wording before comparison.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 1; Theorems 4–5
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Local existence and localization of nuisance-perturbed conditional and price roots, score orthogonality, and the uniform quadratic remainder are not established in the core.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The uniform Gaussian endpoint band and full-ray breakdown coverage are conditional on an affirmative resolution of Open-ended Question 1; the population sharpness and dual claims are not thereby assumed.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article studies a one-treatment average-case sensitivity model parameterized by a second moment of a propensity-score ratio, derives sharp optimization bounds, efficient one-step estimators, and multiplier-bootstrap sensitivity-curve bands.

Tan studies longitudinal time-varying treatments and covariates, distinguishes primary, joint, and product sensitivity models, and gives population sharp and conservative convex-optimization representations.

The archival preprint allows static or time-varying treatments, considers propensity-, outcome-, and subset-confounding MSM restrictions, and develops efficient estimators and confidence intervals for bounds.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace B_beta(delta) by an explicitly specified product Banach neighborhood intersected with tilde-pi_t in [epsilon/2,1-epsilon/2] almost surely, and define the perturbed residual and score on that domain before asserting Frechet derivatives.

Delete the exponential/Kullback--Leibler description of the face optimizer; state the clipped-affine quadratic-perspective mechanism and anchor any Zhang Proposition 3 comparison to the exact primary-version formula.

State a formal inclusion or strict non-representability theorem against Tan's published range-bounded class, including a nonatomic feasible unbounded-ratio construction, rather than the current universal unbounded-ratio sentence.
